facts.text: EMORA is an AI character chat platform for meaningful interactions.
EMORA provides infinite memory so AI characters retain conversational context from past interactions.
EMORA integrates image generation, letting users create visual content within their chats.
EMORA has a character bonding system for deeper, more personalized connections with AI characters.
EMORA has a creator economy where users can design, share, and monetize their own AI characters and worlds.
EMORA offers a free-to-start model so users can begin without an initial cost.
EMORA fosters a creator community where users share, collaborate, and give feedback on character designs.
EMORA supports group chats where multiple AI characters can take part in the same conversation.
EMORA has a creator currency called GEM; creators earn GEM when other users chat with the characters they created.
EMORA lets users unlock story content by building their relationship with a character over time.
EMORA supports private one-on-one conversations with AI characters.
EMORA is operated by Toast Co., Ltd. (주식회사 토스트), a company based in Incheon, South Korea.
